newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Railtrack calls active ahead of H1.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Railtrack calls active ahead of H1.

text.p: Options on Railtrack, set to report on Friday its first set of interim results as a publicly traded company, were among the few stock options that were active on Monday.
Dealers noted a buyer of some 500 December 300 calls on the UK rail utility at 7p.
Analysts expected the recently-privatised Railtrack to report six-month profits rose close to 150 million stg, up from proforma 98 million the same period a year ago.
The shares were up 13p to 289p by 1447 GMT.

Elsewhere, a bullish spread was seen in RTZ options in the wake of a steep share price decline last week. Dealers noted a buyer of some 700 February 1000 calls on RTZ against the purchase of some 700 February 900 puts.
Put options on B.A.T Industries were active, with total volume of 1,760 lots by 1447 GMT all on the put side.
Dealers said most of the put trades were part of put spreads, but it was unclear whether the spreads were newly established positions or rolled over from November options, which expire next week.
Shares in B.A.T were 1p lower at 419-1/2p.
Dealers said 500 February 330 straddles were sold in Tesco options. A short straddle position is profitable when volatility in the underlying shares is low.

Trading in index options was featureless. They said some out-of-the-money December puts, with strikes between 3,575 and 3,725, were sold. But most of the trading volume was in the November 3,800 puts, November 3925 and 3975 calls and December 4100 calls.
